entries.32c569eae8a78325: The group consists of the company, 59 consolidated subsidiaries and 4 equity-method affiliates (as of March 31, 2026). Consolidated employees number 7,896, and the head office is located in Matsuyama, Ehime Prefecture.
entries.3994e139e6122277: The company manufactures and sells boilers, including small once-through boilers, water treatment equipment, marine equipment, food processing equipment, medical equipment and laundry equipment, and also provides maintenance services such as paid maintenance management (ZMP) contracts.
entries.3b48478bcb696fed: Steam Boilers and Hot Water Boilers
entries.3e0207457f44f831: Customers are factories, business sites and ships that use steam or hot water. There are no customers for which transactions with a single external customer account for 10% or more of revenue.
entries.49087727d85bcf9a: Profit is what remains after deducting costs such as material purchases, manufacturing, sales and maintenance from revenue. Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥27,621 million.
entries.5208838376874da4: Businesses such as factories and business sites that use heat and water
entries.5bedf9b6cd8251c8: A machinery manufacturer that makes heat, water and environmental equipment centered on boilers, and conducts equipment manufacturing and sales and maintenance in Japan, the Americas, Asia and other regions.
entries.776e4c89486d6ffc: Subsidiaries in South Korea, China, Taiwan, Southeast Asia and Europe are responsible.
entries.8d8c0d421c7e32ff: The company and its domestic consolidated subsidiaries are responsible. They manufacture and sell boilers and related equipment, including steam boilers and hot water boilers, water treatment equipment, marine equipment, food processing equipment, medical equipment and laundry equipment, and also provide maintenance, including paid maintenance contracts (ZMP). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥138,818 million, the largest of the 3 regional segments.
entries.8f212b622c2c0ce5: A three-year medium-term management plan has been in progress since the fiscal year ended March 2026. Aiming to become a 'super maintenance company' (a company that stays continuously connected with customers through its products and services), it plans in Japan to expand its business by providing total solutions using proprietary technologies in the heat, water and environment fields, and overseas, as a 'heat provider', to advance measures such as expanding its network of bases in each area. The revenue target for the fiscal year ending March 2028, the final year of the plan, is ¥300,000 million.

entries.974ca19b207c0e9a: Even after selling equipment, the company has a business structure in which it stays continuously connected with customers through paid maintenance management (ZMP) contracts and other maintenance services. Maintenance is the second-largest source of revenue by product and service.
entries.985a15c267fbd4f6: Subsidiaries in South Korea, China, Taiwan, Southeast Asia and Europe are responsible. They manufacture and sell steam boilers and heat medium boilers and provide maintenance. CERTUSS GmbH in Germany is a boiler manufacturer that became a subsidiary in 2024. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥38,617 million.

entries.c2ef8a953d40272b: The segment note's information on products and services prints maintenance revenue from external customers of ¥92,726 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (second after boilers and related equipment at ¥134,077 million), and the Business Description lists ZMP (paid maintenance management) contracts.
entries.c4b1d36f1464b49a: Steam Boilers and Heat Medium Boilers
entries.d11d55b8f3060710: The source of revenue is equipment sales and maintenance. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥268,701 million, up 6.9% from the previous consolidated fiscal year. By product and service, boilers and related equipment were ¥134,077 million, maintenance ¥92,726 million, and water-tube boilers and cooling and heating equipment ¥41,847 million.
entries.d367a0142aacf375: It is a manufacturer that operates worldwide in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of boilers and related equipment; revenue is largest in the Japan domestic business, followed by the Americas business and the Asia and Other business, in that order. The large increase in revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2025 was due to the acquisition as subsidiaries of The Cleaver-Brooks Company, Inc. in the United States and others.
entries.e1e5c7ac76401489: Subsidiaries in the United States, Canada, Mexico and Brazil are responsible. They manufacture and sell steam boilers and hot water boilers and provide maintenance. The Cleaver-Brooks Company, Inc. in the United States is a boiler manufacturer that became a subsidiary in 2024. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥91,264 million.
entries.f85a7a292daac085: Income from paid maintenance management contracts and paid maintenance
entries.fafb0c3134ba0a16: The segment note prints revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 (Japan ¥138,818 million, Americas ¥91,264 million, Asia and Other ¥38,617 million), and the five-year trend shows revenue rising from ¥159,695 million for the fiscal year ended March 2024 to ¥251,341 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025.
